lines: It found a flight in 7 point 1 seconds with all waits included.
Developers waste time on slow browser loops and heavy protocols.
Jev Ultrafast is a Python library that lets you build web agents for developers.
It uses an atomic DOM snapshot and indexed controls to wait for useful states within milliseconds.
Type a goal to open an article or filter hotels, then see it run instantly.
Median task time went from 9.450 s → 7.092 s.
The code is small enough to read, with agent.py holding the complete loop and text-helper handoff.
It includes a flight search script and renders demos at one times speed.
Clone the repo on GitHub, run uv sync in your terminal, then make a copy of env.example.
Send this to someone who needs a faster web agent.
That speed comes from browser-use slash jev-ultrafast.
